common.name: Your name
common.securityCheckHint: Please complete the security check above.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Free during the beta. No card needed.
signup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short phrase is easy to remember.
signup.sentBody: If {{email}} can be used, we've sent a link to finish setting up your account. It expires in 24 hours.
signup.terms: By creating an account you agree to the draft Terms and Privacy Policy.

login.title: Welcome back
login.captcha: Please complete the security check to continue.
login.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.used: This link has already been used
verify.resent: If your account still needs confirming, a new link is on its way.
verify.banner: Please confirm your email address. We sent a link to {{email}}.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, you'll get a link to reset your password. It expires in 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Password changed. You've been signed out everywhere, so please log in again.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.wrongAccount: You're signed in with a different email
invite.wrongAccountBody: This invitation was sent to {{email}}. Sign out and log in with that email to accept it.
invite.accepted: This invitation has already been used
invite.askAgain: Ask the studio for a new invitation.

onboarding.title: How will you use SnapShare?
onboarding.studioBody: Upload events, share galleries with guests and clients, and manage your team.
onboarding.personalBody: Private albums and groups for family and friends.
onboarding.verifyFirst: Confirm your email first, then you can create your studio.

account.title: Account settings
account.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
account.sessionsBody: Sign out of any device you don't recognise.
account.noOthers: No other devices are signed in.

workspace.noAccess: You don't have access to this studio
workspace.noAccessBody: It may not exist, or you may not be a member. Ask the owner for an invitation.

studioProfile.title: Studio profile
studioProfile.gstOwnerOnly: Only the owner can change billing details.
studioProfile.dangerBody: Deleting starts a 30-day grace period. During it, you can cancel. Afterwards the studio and all its data are permanently removed.
studioProfile.deleteConfirm: Enter your password to schedule deletion
studioProfile.pending: This studio is scheduled for deletion on {{date}}.

team.title: Team
team.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the studio? They lose access immediately.
team.readOnly: You can view the team. Only owners and admins can make changes.
